reviews.text:
Aleese doesn't like been groomed but she always looks great, lovely job and great staff
Love the tail blow out yesterday  x
came in to get my dog's teeth cleaned, came out with nice white teeth!

Daisy did a great job of grooming my dog Buddy. This was our first visit and he left the groomers looking so handsome.

Our regular groomers had unfortunately shut down and we were on the hunt for new groomers. So glad we gave Daisy's Dogs a try. Buddy can be anxious and his groom was long overdue, but Daisy did an amazing job with his groom! Highly recommend!
Amazing service, incredible decor and vibe!
Always the best grooms with Daisy. She has been looking after my mini schnauzer since he was a pup and we couldn't be happier with the amazing care and attention.

Daisy’s Dogs are the absolute best - always super professional and clearly have so much love for all dogs. I always feel confident leaving Moose with them, knowing he’s in the safest of hands ❤️ Also a great selection of treats to buy which he also loves! Highly recommend!

This was Teddie's first visit to Daisy's Dogs. We were initially given good advice about how to brush Teddie (a Cavapoochon) to avoid matting in her 'under' coat. Off she then went for a full groom. She came back looking like a different dog! From a fluff ball to a neat-as-a-pin gorgeous girl.
Teddie seemed calm when I picked her up. I hope she behaved herself as I've booked her in for a Tidy Up appointment in 6 weeks!
Thanks to Daisy and Emma for your care and expertise.
